								375 container At 14:20 UTC on Tuesday, the export service began returning incomplete CSV files for projects with more than 10,000 records. Projects below that threshold were not affected, and PDF exports continued to work. We disabled CSV export at 14:47 rather than risk customers downloading partial data. The team traced the issue to a pagination change released on Monday. We rolled that change back at 16:10, then checked 25 previously affected projects and found complete row counts in all 25. CSV export was restored at 16:35. We have not yet determined why the pre-release load test missed the fault. By Friday, the platform team will add a case above 10,000 records and will report whether other paginated exports need the same coverage. No customer action is required, but anyone who downloaded a CSV between 14:20 and 14:47 should export it again.

									389 text The root of the problem was a pagination change introduced on Monday, the team traced. We rolled the change back at 16:10, then looked at 25 projects that had previously been affected and found full row counts in all. CSV export was restored at 16:35. So we still asked why the fault was not caught in the load test itself, as it happened pre-release. The platform team will add a case above 10,000 records by Friday and report back if any other paginated exports require this coverage. Customers do not need to take any action – but anyone who downloaded a CSV between 14:20 and 14:47 should export it again.
